item.ptxt: Check accessory drive belt when engine is cool and the belt is dry.
If the check result is not OK even though the accessory drive belt is replaced with a new one, replace the tensioner.

s1.ptxt: Hoist vehicle and remove right side engine under side cover.
Remove right side front fender lining.
Check accessory drive belt for crack, cuts, deformation, wear and cleanliness. If it is necessary to replace the belt, refer to Accessory Drive Belt Removal and Installation:K14D .
Fitting wrench to hexagonal section (1) of accessory drive belt lower tensioner, compress the tensioner by turning it clockwise until holes (2) align, and then fix the position inserting a pin.
Fitting wrench to hexagonal section (1) of accessory drive belt upper tensioner, give pressure to the belt by turning the tensioner clockwise until it stops.

attention3.ptxt: The turning stops at about 10 N·m (1.0 kgf-m, 7.5 lbf-ft).
In this state, the tensioner makes specified belt tension for inspection.
Therefore, do not apply torque excessively.

s1.ptxt: Looking up accessory drive belt upper tensioner (1), check that indicator line (2) is located within range “a” of protrusion.
If not, replace accessory drive belt.

attention3.ptxt: Indicators (3) (line and protrusion) are not for this engine model. Do not misread.

s1.ptxt: Remove fixing pin from accessory drive belt lower tensioner, turn crankshaft and check the belt for smooth running.
Reinstall removed parts to original positions.
